sentences.en: They say our house is too small by Western standards.
sentences.zh: 按照西方的标准，我们的房子太小了。

sentences.en: Western clothes are easier to work in than Japanese clothes.
sentences.zh: 与日本服装相比，西方服装更便于工作。

sentences.en: A terrible battle took place at Kasserine in western Tunisia.
sentences.zh: 在突尼斯西部的凯尔泽因发生了一场可怕的战斗。

senses.zh: 西方的，西部的；西方国家的，西方文化的
